# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Get current directory name for archive naming
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$PWD")

# Generate timestamp
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# Create archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${CURRENT_DIR}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    .

echo "Archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
